block.comment: ORACLE UPDATED V3: change the numbers in this block before you run the bot. The bot reads the market for you. SIDE: every time a trade starts it counts the last digits of the ticks it holds. If digits 0 and 1 are the quietest it plans Over 1. If digits 8 and 9 are the quietest it plans Under 8. ENTRY: Over 1 waits for a 1 and then a higher digit. Under 8 waits for an 8 and then a lower digit. USE LIMIT = 1 also needs the two quiet digits to be each below LIMIT PERCENT (10.5%) of the ticks (at least MIN TICKS). USE LIMIT = 0 trades on the pattern alone. RUNS = how many Over 1 / Under 8 trades it makes before it stops (3 by default, set any number). RECOVERY: a loss on Over 1 recovers on Under 6, then on Over 3. A loss on Under 8 recovers on Over 3, then on Under 6. RECOVERY OVER DIGIT = 3 and RECOVERY UNDER DIGIT = 6. Stakes are worked out from the payout so a win gets back the whole loss (RECOVERY MARGIN 1.05, PAYOUT FACTOR 9.53). STOP AFTER RECOVERY = 1 stops the bot when the recovery is over, 0 lets it carry on until RUNS is reached. MAX STAKE = if a recovery stake would be higher than this the bot goes back to the start. STOP LOSS and TAKE PROFIT = session limits in dollars. Keep MAX RECOVERY at 2. Leave the other variables as they are.
